blocks.text: عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Read as "Alayhis Salaam", this Arabic term means "Peace be upon him" and is used as a term of respect and a prayer after the names of Allaah's Ambiyaa (prophets) and angels.
عَلَيْهِمُ السَّلَامُ: Read as "Alayhimus Salaam", this Arabic term means "Peace be upon them" and is used as a term of respect and a prayer after the names of Allaah's Ambiyaa (prophets) and angels.

رَضِيَ اللّٰهُ عَنْهُ: Read as "Radhi Yallaahu Ta'aalaa Anhu", this Arabic term means "May Allaah be pleased with him". It is used as a term of respect and as a prayer after the name of any one of the male Sahabah (RA).

رَضِيَ اللّٰهُ عَنْهَا: Read as "Radhi Yallaahu Ta'aalaa Anhaa", this Arabic term means "May Allaah be pleased with her". It is used as a term of respect and as a prayer after the name of any one of the female Sahabah (RA).

رَضِيَ اللّٰهُ عَنْهُمَا: Read as "Radhi Yallaahu Ta'aalaa Anhumaa", this Arabic term means "May Allaah be pleased with the two of them". It is used as a term of respect and as a prayer after the name of any two male or female Sahabah (RA).

رَضِيَ اللّٰهُ عَنْهُمْ: Read as "Radhi Yallaahu Ta'aalaa Anhum", this Arabic term means "May Allaah be pleased with them". It is used as a term of respect and as a prayer after the word "Sahabah" or after the names of a few Sahabah.
ﷺ: read as "Sallallaahu Alayhi wa Sallam" and is used after the name and titles of Rasulullaah ﷺ. The term means "May Allaah shower mercy and peace on him" i.e. on Rasulullaah ﷺ.

رَحِمَهُ اللّٰهُ تَعَالَى: Read as "Rahima Hullaah Ta'aalaa", this Arabic term means "May Allaah have mercy on him". It is used as a term of respect and as a prayer after the name of any pious person.
تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: Read as "Tabarak wa Ta'aalaa", this Arabic term means "The most honoured and mighty". It is used only after the name of Allaah.
